preconditions.description: The number of balls n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of swaps m must be between 1 and 200,000.
The initial position k of the special ball must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in swaps)
preconditions.description: Each swap must involve distinct positions within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
Each output integer must be non-negative or -1.
The output integer at position k must be 0, indicating no swaps needed for the initial position.
